title: A lookup's stored revalidation keeps only the last question's lines, so a source past its lifetime is asked again for every new question
goal: factdiff.lookup_store merges the lines of earlier revalidations of a source still within the reuse window into its stored record instead of replacing them, so a lookup that prints another fact of a source revalidated moments ago reuses the stored result and does not ask the source again: the repro, which stores two results of one source with different lines and asks for the first, exits 0.

run: import sys,time; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import factdiff as f, kbcommon; f.ROOT=kbcommon.root('public'); s='S-review-etslk6yu'; n=time.time(); f.lookup_store(s,{'checked':n,'lines':{'A':{'outcome':'current'}}}); f.lookup_store(s,{'checked':n,'lines':{'B':{'outcome':'current'}}}); sys.exit(0 if f.lookup_cached(s,['A'],3600,n) else 1)

gates.question: Which window does lookup_store merge an earlier stored result within, and which check time does the merged record keep?

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 6 of 19, "Freshness at lookup: revalidation compares the right window and remembers what it checked"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise: the stored result of a source keeps only the last store. Run 2026-10-12 on origin/main: the repro stores {A} then {B} for one source and lookup_cached for A returns None (exit 1): reproduces. The check varies the cache inputs: a stored result older than the reuse window is dropped, not merged, and a changed verdict replaces the stored lines. The test name carries lookup_store_merges_lines_within_reuse_window. Run after BG-f3d6lirf: all change factdiff.py. From the SP-etslk6yu review (factdiff.py lookup_cached, lookup_store): Q1 prints fact A of S and stores A, Q2 prints B and misses, re-asks and stores B, Q3 prints A and re-asks again; the existing test replays identical lines, so it never hits this.

run: import sys,time; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import factdiff as f, kbcommon; f.ROOT=kbcommon.root('public'); s='S-review-etslk6yu'; n=time.time(); f.lookup_store(s,{'checked':n,'lines':{'A':{'outcome':'current'}}}); f.lookup_store(s,{'checked':n,'lines':{'B':{'outcome':'current'}}}); sys.exit(0 if f.lookup_cached(s,['A'],3600,n) else 1)
